instruction: Candid documentary medium-wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and a printer in the background. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right, placing her right hand on the shoulder of the man in the black cap and dark polo shirt (R1). The man (R1) stands on the right, facing left, looking at her. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the room, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R2 places her right hand on R1's shoulder
R1 is the person receiving shoulder contact from R2
R2 faces R1 while making the shoulder contact
R1 faces and looks at R2 during the contact
